inputs.text: [curious] Liopleurodon. Three little Greek pieces: "leios" means smooth. [serious] "Pleura," the side. "Odon," tooth.
[happily] Right — no little ridges on them, like some shark teeth have. He lived one hundred sixty-five million years ago, [amazed] in the seas of Europe, [confident] in France and England.
[curious] And how did he hunt, with a lizard's nose?
[confident] Not with his eyes first — [serious] with his sense of smell. His nostrils pointed forward, like a dog tracking a scent.
